''14. Sinne no more.'') We may gather hereby that this mans long infirmitie was for punishment of his {{ls}}innes, and that men often attribute their {{ls}}icknes to other natural defects, and {{ls}}eeke for remedies of the world in vaine, when the {{ls}}inne for which it was {{ls}}ent, {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=Sinne the cau{{ls}}e of {{ls}}icknes and infirmities.}}remaineth, or is not repented of: and therfore that in al infirmities men {{ls}}hould fir{{ls}}t turne to God & goe to their Gho{{ls}}tly father, and then call for the wordly Phi{{ls}}icions afterward.

''34. I receiue not.'') Our Mai{{ls}}ter meaneth that mans te{{ls}}timonie is not nece{{ls}}sarie to him, nor that the truth of his Diuinitie dependeth on worldly witne{{ls}}{{ls}}es or mens commendations: though to vs {{ls}}uch te{{ls}}timonies be agreable and nece{{ls}}sarie. and {{ls}}o for our in{{ls}}truction he vouch{{ls}}aued to take the te{{ls}}timonies of Iohn the Bapti{{ls}}t and Moy{{ls}}es and the Prophets: and departing out of this world, to {{ls}}end forth al his Apo{{ls}}tles, and in them al Bi{{ls}}hops and Lawful Pa{{ls}}tors, to be his witne{{ls}}{{ls}}es from Hieru{{ls}}alem to the ends of the world.

''39. Searche the Scriptures.'') He reprehendeth the Iewes, that reading daily the Scriptures and acknowledging that in them they {{ls}}hould finde life and {{ls}}aluation, they yet looked ouer them {{ls}}o {{ls}}uperficially that they could not finde therein him to be {{sc|Christ}} their King, {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=Neither Ievves nor Heretikes finde the truth, becau{{ls}}e they {{ls}}earche not the Scriptures deepely, but read {{ls}}uperficially.}}Lord, life, and Sauiour. For the {{ls}}pecial mai{{ls}}ters & Scribes of the Ievves then, were like vnto our Heretikes now, vvho be euer talking and turning and {{ls}}huffling the Scriptures, but are of al men mo{{ls}}t ignorant in the deepe knovvledge thereof. And therfore our Mai{{ls}}ter referreth them not to the reading onely or learning them without booke, or hauing the {{ls}}entences thereof gloriou{{ls}}ly painted or vvritten in thier Temple, hou{{ls}}es, or coates: but to the deepe {{ls}}earche of the meaning and my{{ls}}teries of the Scriptures, which are not {{ls}}o ea{{ls}}ily to be {{ls}}een in the letter.
